newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Tonawanda, N.Y..

text.p: at the offices of Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street,
Bonds dated April 15, 1997, interest payable April 15, 1998, October 15, 1998 and semi-annually thereafter on April 15 and October 15. Bonds mature in principal installments on October 15 as follows:
Bids, accompanied by $42,280 good faith deposit check, must be for all $2,114,000 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Munistat Services, Inc., 12 Roosevelt Avenue, Port Jefferson Station, New York, 11776, telephone number (516) 331-8888; fax (516) 331-8834; e-mail
